subject: Workshop on R statistical package breedR

messages.subject: Workshop on R statistical package breedR
parts:
Dear Colleagues,

In the frame of the Trees4Future project  (http://www.trees4future.eu/), we are inviting for a workshop concerning  the use of the statistical package breedR. The workshop will be held at the Forest Research Institute, Sekocin Stary, Poland (10-11 December 2015).

The package breedR provides frequentist and Bayesian statistical tools to build predictive models useful for breeders, quantitative genetists and forest genetic resources analysts communities. It aims to assess the genetic value of individuals under a number of situations, including spatial autocorrelation, genetic/environment interaction and competition.

Workshop will be led by Leopoldo Schanchez and Facundo Muñoz from INRA (Orléans) with the help of local organizers.

Participants are obliged to cover their costs of travel, meals and accommodation. There is no other fee to attend in the workshop.

 

The registration is possible until 4 December.
